## Invitations

During the reporting period, 2397 invitations were issued for the outreach activity. Attendance totalled 678 people, representing a participation rate of 28.3 per cent. The attendance level has been recorded for monitoring and will inform future outreach activity.

The invitation process was supported by standard follow-up arrangements. Staff will continue to review attendance and contact people who did not attend their scheduled appointments. This approach is intended to maintain engagement and support access for people who may require further assistance.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS: the recorded total was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the recorded total for reminders was also 0. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, where follow-up is appropriate. These contacts provide an opportunity to confirm whether further support or a new appointment is required.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
